top_signals.title: Taiwan Dethrones Korea Atop Global Markets
top_signals.summary: Taiwan is emerging as the stronger bet for equity investors due to its deeper linkages across the AI supply chain and a more upbeat earnings outlook. Bloomberg's Winnie Hsu breaks down the news. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: DeepSeek considers doubling latest funding round to up to $15 billion, sources say
top_signals.summary: China's DeepSeek weighs upsizing funding round to up to $14.9 billion, sources tell CNBC, and the final amount could still change in final talks.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Tennessee execution survivor Christa Pike is conscious and speaking, lawyers say
top_signals.summary: Despite severe injuries sustained during the aborted execution, Pike, 50, is "still handcuffed and shackled" to her hospital bed.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.
